title: Publish refuses a release whose Content coverage is missing or stale, without changing GitHub, under the shared ops-quickstarts harness
steps: S1: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set, run node --test apps/tracy-web/test/ops-quickstarts.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/content-coverage.test.mjs.
expect: S1: every test passes, including 'Publish refuses missing Content coverage without changing GitHub' and 'Publish refuses stale Content coverage without changing GitHub' (400 CONTENT_COVERAGE_NOT_READY, GitHub assets unchanged).
evidence: On develop 4115f6873 both tests answered 200 instead of 400 because the harness injected an always-measured coverage (#146) that hid the fixture #80's tests change.
fence: the realCoverage option of the ops-quickstarts harness
